fields.description: What this rule is for, in the words a manager would use. Shown in the rule list and on every execution log row.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Record created fires once, when the record is inserted. Stage changed and Field changed fire only on a REAL transition: a save that does not move the field does nothing.
fields.label: Event
fields.options:
Record created
Field changed
Stage changed

fields.description: The fieldname to watch, for the Field changed event. Stage changed always watches status.
fields.label: Watched Field

fields.description: OFF by default. Two switches must be on before a rule can fire: this one and Workflow rules in Settings, Feature Flags.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: How many actions this rule may run in one day. The slot is reserved atomically, so two workers cannot spend the same last slot. 0 means unlimited. Reaching the cap notifies the rule's owner once a day.
fields.label: Daily Action Cap

fields.description: Which records this rule applies to. Same shape as an assignment rule's condition: a JSON list of [field, operator, value] rows joined by and / or, with optional nested groups.
fields.label: If

fields.description: Written by the engine. The counter and the day are updated in ONE statement, which is what makes the cap safe under two workers.
fields.label: Daily Counter

fields.description: The day the counter above belongs to. A counter from an older day is reset by the same statement that spends the next slot.
fields.label: Counter Day

fields.description: The last day the owner was told this rule hit its cap. Claimed by one atomic update, so the owner is told once a day and not once per refused action.
fields.label: Cap Notified On
